title: Degree-zero continuity for the specified inverse image
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale [def-sc-zariski-site] [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with i followed by the forgetful functor to Over X equal to X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. Let H be a functor between the abelian etale sheaf categories on X and Spec(O_X,x), with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. If H is left adjoint to direct image along X.fromSpecStalk x, the functor etaleObjectStalkSections X i x is naturally isomorphic to H followed by sections on the terminal etale object of the local scheme. This statement specifies H by adjunction, not just by preservation of epimorphisms.

source.place: Degree zero of Lemma 59.51.5, proof steps (1)-(3), on the cofinal principal neighbourhoods of a fixed affine neighbourhood; uniqueness of left adjoints transports to H.

proof.text: Construct the natural comparison from the displayed adjunction unit, canonical maps of the local scheme into each supplied open object, and colimit.desc. The construction includes neighbourhood and sheaf naturality and the formula for each colimit coprojection.

Represent any two stalk elements by neighbourhood sections using Concrete.colimit_exists_rep. The coprojection formula turns equality of their comparison images into equality of the corresponding cocone legs. Descent of equality supplies a common smaller neighbourhood with equal restrictions; Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_of_exists identifies the two stalk elements.
Descent of sections represents every local-scheme section by a neighbourhood section. Its colimit coprojection maps to that section by the coprojection formula, proving surjectivity.

ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective makes every component of the already natural comparison an isomorphism. NatIso.ofComponents with the comparison naturality proves the required Nonempty natural isomorphism. The given H and adjunction are used directly; no arbitrary inverse-image functor is chosen.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree zero, proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to principal opens in an affine neighbourhood of x.

theorem strictHenselian_stalkSections_comparison_iso
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor) (x : X)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ (X.fromSpecStalk x).Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology
      (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).smallEtaleTopology) :
    Nonempty (etaleObjectStalkSections X i x ≅
      H ⋙ (sheafSections (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 _))))
